ei.title: Luna's Cake Mix-up at the Bakery
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Luna's Cake Mix-up at the Bakery

fullPassage: Luna went to the bakery to pick up a chocolate cake for her dad's 70th birthday. As she opened the box, she couldn't understand what she saw. It was a lemon cake. Then she noticed the message on top. It said, "Happy 50th Birthday, Dad!" Luna said to the baker, "I don't get it. The flavor and the message are wrong." She wondered if she made a mistake when ordering. The baker asked her to wait and walked away. Moments later, he returned with her cake, explaining they had received two similar orders. Knowing she had chosen a quality bakery, Luna said, "I see. Well, this looks perfect, even better than I imagined."

questions.passage: Luna went to the bakery to pick up a (A)[vanilla / chocolate] cake for her dad's 70th birthday. As she opened the box, she couldn't understand what she saw. It was a lemon cake. Then she noticed the message on top. It said, "Happy 50th Birthday, Dad!" Luna said to the baker, "I don't get it. The flavor and the message are (B)[wrong / correct]." She wondered if she made a mistake when ordering. The baker asked her to wait and walked away. Moments later, he returned with her cake, explaining they had received two similar orders. Knowing she had chosen a (C)[cheap / quality] bakery, Luna said, "I see. Well, this looks perfect, even better than I imagined."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① vanilla(바닐라) — wrong — quality: vanilla가 틀림. 초콜릿 케이크를 주문
❌ ② chocolate — correct(맞는) — quality: correct가 틀림. 맛과 메시지가 wrong(틀렸다)
✅ ③ chocolate(초콜릿) — wrong(틀린) — quality(양질의): 원문 일치 ← 정답
❌ ④ chocolate — wrong — cheap(싸구려): cheap이 틀림. 좋은(quality) 빵집을 골랐다
det.tip: chocolate cake, wrong flavor/message, quality bakery

det.analysis:
